page.layout: One column of running text. Three marginal notes in the left margin: "Distinctio Misericordiae Dei" beside the paragraph beginning "Hinc", "Applicatio" beside "Illa perpetuò utitur", and "Confutatio" beside "cata requirat". Running head at top. Catchword "dis" at lower right.

main_text.p: giunt, punit & perdit. Hac Deus perpetuò utitur. Alia, quâ peccatores nonnunquam, neq; contumaces, neq; omnino desperatos, eorum pœniten-tia non exspectata ex sua lege punit; vel etiamsi velit, quanquam resipiscentes, promissione misericordiæ suæ, qua se volens quodammodo nobis devinxit, exclusa, punire potest.

Distinctio Misericor-dia DeiHinc una Misericordia Dei illis dicitur, quâ resipiscentibus, ut ipsius promissa ferunt, omnia scelera condonat, & salutem vitamque largitur. Altera, quâ planè homines prævenit, & peccatis adhuc immersos, ad se vocat & allicit, gratuitóque ne cogitantibus nobis delictorum veniam & salutem offert. ApplicatioIlla perpetuò utitur, hacverò tum demum, cum liber. Cæterum cum tradunt ad infirmandum argumentum nostrum, nullam esse in Deo talem justitiam, quæ punitionem ob peccata requirat, modò peccator resipiscat, expresse pugnant cum absoluta Dei sententia, adversus peccatores lata,

page.notes: The catchword "dis" is faint; the page-number mark at the top is hard to read and may be "166". The marginal note "Confutatio" is partly obscured and is read from its shape. "Applicatio" is in bold italic and is read with some doubt. The Genesis reference is printed in italic within the text line; "Genef." is read as printed. The hyphen in "pœniten-tia" and "Misericor-dia" are line-end hyphens. The bottom catchword is set on the same line as the italic word "Quæcunque" and is taken as the page's last word.
